title: fix(ui): preserve roster identity after normalized reads
body:
Related: #159379 and #159382.

## What Problem This Solves

Normalized session-list reads can replace unchanged managed rosters after unrelated events, and inherited roster fixtures fail CI.

## User Impact

Keep unchanged roster publications stable and restore PR validation. No rendered-content, permission, configuration, or stored-data changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Normalize accepted rows to the existing canonical projection before publishing a roster, rather than waiting for a later unrelated event to replace equivalent row objects. The shared roster admission owner serves both primary and managed lists; independent list reads retain their own response metadata. Existing wrong-agent identity assertions remain intact, and their fixture now uses separate response objects.

Also repair the fixtures exposed by normalized reads: replace the fixed three-row map/spread with equivalent explicit copies; compare complete admitted contents rather than raw RPC aliases; preserve the exact admitted result across failed refreshes; check optional field values without requiring undefined own properties; and deliver changed filtered-sidebar fixtures through their query refresh. No suppressions, dropped cases, retries, or timeout changes.

This prerequisite repair supports @steipete’s authorized lint-reduction-and-landing work. The emergency direct-main repair attempt was rejected with `GH013: Changes must be made through a pull request`; this follows that enforced route without bypassing it.

## Work sessions

- [Original discussion with @steipete](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/266b3cfc-7327-4d6d-94db-7dd43895e23b)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/subagent/9c59889d-33b5-40c7-9f8d-a01cee94cca1)

## Evidence

- Reproduced the original `oxc/no-map-spread` diagnostic; explicit copies removed it without changing the 17 tree-snapshot cases.
- [First hosted UI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36292475196/job/108545182574): 16 inherited fixture failures, all reproduced locally and repaired; the lint lane passed.
- [Next hosted run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36293012134): UI shard 1 passed, while shards 2/3 exposed eight more failures. All eight reproduced locally (345 tests, 8 failures). These included the two meaningful post-admission identity failures; their exact-reference assertions were retained and the producer was fixed instead.
- The initial producer placement over-projected independent reads. Broader session tests caught both affected permission/read-metadata contracts, so the correction was moved to roster publication admission; neither test was relaxed.
- Final session boundary proof: **77 files / 1,564 tests pass**, covering the entire sessions directory plus chat-send, unmaterialized settings, and both sidebar suites. Command wall **31.00 s**, Vitest **29.17 s**, using the supported wrapper with one worker. No new test cases or wait budgets.
- Final focused type-aware lint: five newly changed files, 263 rules, **0 diagnostics** (9.5 s); earlier five-file lint also passed. UI typecheck, formatter, line-cap/max-lines ratchets, and `git diff --check` pass. No baseline changes.
- Full-candidate independent autoreview through P2: **scoped-clean, zero findings**. [Final exact-head hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36293803925) passed, including the enforced `openclaw/ci-gate`. [Completed ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159394#issuecomment-5852440187) for `3e0c98c120f17f050cc2aacb8b3033764482c95d` reports no findings.
